citations.quote: Other than collision (comprehensive) coverage (Part D — Coverage for damage to your auto) We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations. Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: missiles or falling objects; fire; theft or larceny; explosion or earthquake; windstorm; hail, water or flood; malicious mischief or vandalism; riot or civil commotion; contact with a bird or animal; or breakage of glass.

output.reasoning: The incident involved a fire caused by an electrical short, which is explicitly listed as a loss covered under comprehensive (other than collision) coverage in COMP-1. No exclusions apply to this type of loss.
